cells.scene: A theatre's deep blue stage curtain is partly drawn open, revealing stage floorboards.
A person lifts a cloth from a small sculpture, revealing the previously hidden object.
A small empty single prison cell contains one bed, a stool and a barred window.
An entirely clean white sheet of paper lies beside a pencil, no marks or text on the paper.
